# What actually gets installed on the VS Code Marketplace

> 64,464 VS Code extensions from 50,446 publishers with the install count the Marketplace publishes for each, measured August 2026. Free, CC BY 4.0, DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21854363. Collector included.

IMPORTANT CAVEAT, please carry it if you quote these numbers: This is not a census and it is head-biased: each category was paged from the most-installed downwards until a cap, so the tail below the cap is missing. Every “under N installs” figure here is therefore a floor, not an estimate — the true share is higher, because everything the crawl did not reach lies below everything it did.

## Headline figures
- Extensions reached: 64,464
- Publishers reached: 50,446 (86.1% have exactly one)
- Installs represented: 5,688,436,895
- Median installs: 804; 25th/75th percentile 133/3,519
- Top 1% of extensions hold 87.4% of installs; top 10% hold 98.0%
- Under 100 installs: 22.5% (a floor); under 1,000: 54.4%
- Installs are not revenue: the VS Code Marketplace has no paid tier.

## Pages
- [Dataset home](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/vscode-marketplace-data/): headline figures, category table, method and limits
- [Do star ratings predict how many people install an extension?](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/vscode-marketplace-data/g/vscode-extension-ratings-do-not-predict-installs.html): They point the wrong way. Five-star extensions have a lower median install count than three-star ones, and the reason matters.
- [How many installs does a new VS Code extension actually get?](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/vscode-marketplace-data/g/how-many-installs-does-a-new-vscode-extension-get.html): By release-year cohort, with the age confound stated rather than hidden.
- [The most-installed VS Code extensions](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/vscode-marketplace-data/g/most-installed-vscode-extensions.html): The top 250 in this sample, with publisher, category and last-updated date.
- [How many VS Code extensions and publishers are there?](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/vscode-marketplace-data/g/how-many-vscode-extensions-are-there.html): What this crawl found, what it could not reach, and why the difference matters.
- [Is it worth publishing a VS Code extension?](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/vscode-marketplace-data/g/is-it-worth-publishing-a-vscode-extension.html): The base rate a new publisher is actually competing against, stated plainly.
- [How much of the VS Code Marketplace is abandoned?](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/vscode-marketplace-data/g/abandoned-vscode-extensions.html): Share not updated in twelve months, by category — and why the stale ones are the bigger ones.
- [Does publishing more extensions help?](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/vscode-marketplace-data/g/vscode-extension-publishers.html): Median best-extension installs by how many a publisher has shipped.
- [VS Code Marketplace statistics, measured](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/vscode-marketplace-data/g/vscode-marketplace-statistics.html): Every headline figure in one place, each one recomputable from the published data.
- [AI extensions](https://sujeito-operator.github.io/vscode-marketplace-data/c/ai.html): 2,040 measured, median 39 installs

## Raw data
- [extensions.jsonl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sujeito-operator/vscode-marketplace-data/main/data/extensions.jsonl) one row per extension
- [extensions.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sujeito-operator/vscode-marketplace-data/main/data/extensions.csv) the same as CSV
- [summary.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sujeito-operator/vscode-marketplace-data/main/data/summary.json) machine-readable summary incl. the caveat
- [repository](https://github.com/sujeito-operator/vscode-marketplace-data) crawler, summariser and site generator
